notes.title: Fritz 20 SE - available on Steam on 16.09.2025!
notes.content:
Fritz 20 SE from 16.09.2025 on SteamSpecial launch discount available on Steam!
The wait is over Fritz 20 SE is here with more power, style, and training options than ever before!

Look forward to Fritz 20 SE. This is new: 

Compete against legends 

Compete with the strategies of the greatest players in history: Morphy, Lasker, Capablanca, Tal, Fischer, Karpov, - with an ELO adapted to you, but in an authentic style.

More highlights in Fritz 20 SE:

Fritz engine now with 3,580 ELO - world-class level

Manual opponent configuration

New game styles: "Romantic" and "Hypermodern"

Bullet training, AI chat, new 3D visuals, game controller support, new achievements

Configure opponent simulation from ChessBase 18-Style Reports
Fritz 20 SE will be released on Steam on 16.09.2025!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841830/Fritz_Chess_20_Steam_Edition/"][/dynamiclink]Dear chess fans,  

Fritz 20 SE will soon be available on Steam! As a ChessBase customer, you have the opportunity to use the latest version of the legendary chess software right here. 

Stay tuned!
